title: Make Array Strictly Increasing
algorithm: Dynamic programming by replacement count, retaining the smallest achievable tail; binary-search replacement choices and prune dominated states.

complexity.time: O(m log m + n^2 log(m + 1)) worst case

domain.operation: Replace any arr1 position with a value from arr2; arr2 values are reusable.
domain.return: Minimum replacements or -1; no output-array mutation required.
